effects: Pulls `assets` USDC (Base USDC 0x8335…2913) from the signer into the vault (standard ERC-4626 behaviour; the implementation behind the beacon could not be read).
Mints vault shares (lmMgUSDC) to `receiver`. The number of shares comes from the vault's exchange rate, and any deposit fee is set by implementation code that is not available.
formats.shown: Deposit, with the USDC amount, a raw constant 'lmMgUSDC' labelled Share ticker, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown; it comes from the vault's exchange rate in storage.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit fields: only `assets`, constant `vaultTicker` (raw) and `receiver`. ERC-4626 deposit has no minShares parameter, so the share amount is not in calldata.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730. A label such as 'Receive shares (lmMgUSDC)' would make clearer that the amount is decided by the vault.

findings.title: deposit: the intent 'Deposit' names neither the asset nor the vault.
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Deposit USDC into Gauntlet USDC Core vault' and add an interpolatedIntent.

effects: Pulls USDC from the signer. The amount is computed from `shares` at the vault's current rate (previewMint, rounded up) and is not in calldata.
formats.shown: Mint, with a raw 'USDC' constant labelled Deposit asset, the share amount, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint: the USDC amount taken from the signer is not shown; it comes from the share price in storage.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint field {label:'Deposit asset', format:'raw', value:'$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker'} shows only the ticker 'USDC'. ERC-4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter.
findings.fix: None possible for the amount. Relabel the field 'Pays in (amount set by vault)' so the bare ticker does not look like a complete amount.

findings.title: mint: 'Deposit asset' displays only a ticker, so it looks like an amount field with no value.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint: label 'Deposit asset', format 'raw', value '$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker' (renders 'USDC').
findings.fix: Relabel it 'Paid in' or 'Asset spent', or put the asset in the intent: 'Mint vault shares paying USDC'.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns the shares needed for `assets` (previewWithdraw, rounded up) from `owner`. When the signer is not `owner`, this spends the owner's share allowance to the signer.
Sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`. Any withdrawal fee depends on implementation code that is not available.
formats.shown: Withdraw, with the exact USDC amount, the receiver and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is not shown; it comes from the vault rate.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json withdraw fields: `assets`, `receiver`, `owner`. ERC-4626 withdraw has no maxShares parameter.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent 'Withdraw' does not name USDC or the vault.
findings.fix: Use 'Withdraw USDC from vault' and an interpolatedIntent with the amount and receiver.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `owner`. When the signer is not `owner`, this spends the owner's share allowance to the signer.
Sends USDC worth `shares` (previewRedeem, minus any fee set by implementation code that is not available) to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Redeem, with the number of shares, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: redeem: the USDC received is not shown; it comes from the vault rate and there is no minimum.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json redeem fields: `shares` (tokenAmount @.to), `receiver`, `owner`. ERC-4626 redeem has no minAssets parameter.
findings.fix: None for the amount. Add the underlying ticker to the intent ('Redeem shares for USDC') so the asset received is stated.

findings.title: redeem: nothing on the screen says the shares are redeemed for USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json redeem intent "Redeem". Fields have no underlying ticker, unlike mint, which shows `underlyingTicker`.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Redeem vault shares for USDC' or add a field with value $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker labelled 'Receive asset'.
